{{Quote|I am Ceremony, Gala and Ritual droid designation CGR-80. You may call me "Seeger." Shall we begin your joining?|CGR-80|<ref name="Modest" />}}
'''Ceremony, Gala, and Ritual droids''' were a type of [[Protocol droid/Legends|protocol droid]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] and [[Galactic War]] between the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] that were programmed to perform a wide variety of ceremonies and rituals for their clients. These ceremonies ranged from performing [[Marriage/Legends|marriages]] through the [[Terms of Bonding]] to presiding over [[Rodian harvest festival]]s, as [[CGR-80]] did.<ref name="Modest" />

==Behind the scenes==
A Ceremony, Gala, and Ritual droid, CGR-80, first appeared in the conversation "A Modest Proposal" with [[Archiban Frodrick Kimble|Doc]], a companion character for the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] class in the [[2011]] [[BioWare]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', where he performs a marriage for female Knights and Doc.<ref name="Modest" />
